development_failures.failure: First expanded probe-report serialization failed because a comparison value was a Python set.
development_failures.resolution: Serialized sorted module lists instead; the complete 57-case probe rerun passed. No production evidence was changed.

findings.finding: A substantive proof error could coexist with an unrecognized parser or compiler-crash diagnostic and still count as a valid negative rejection.
findings.resolution: The negative classifier now rejects additional expected-token, unexpected-eof, panic, exception, resource and internal-error signatures. Signal exit codes and timeouts were already rejected.

findings.finding: The build-record helper could accept a matching missing-import digest until the complete release graph rejected the missing artifact.
findings.resolution: The helper explicitly rejects any absent import-output digest. The final release also checks every current local source and output.

findings.finding: Inherited regression source hashes omitted most fixture files, permitting fixture bytes to change after the recorded regression.
findings.resolution: The regression runner now includes every file under examples/robust_quote, examples/calibration and examples/lazy_staged in its current source hashes.

inspection: Read all eleven declared release tools, including the version-in-middle build_v041_parallel.py.
Checked empty and wrong-type JSON rejection, stale source/log/import/object rejection, compiler pin binding, and negative substantive-diagnostic requirements.
Checked exact release build and named-theorem inventory membership plus current full audit log re-evaluation.
Checked that independent review covers all new AVOC modules, including modules without named theorem declarations.
Checked pinned inherited baseline record, inherited mathematical/Python sources, historical evidence hashes and current archived-observation oracle inputs.
Checked recorder-oracle section/count/status/input membership and eighteen contiguous actual-Lean batch records.
Checked bounded oracle completion/provenance linkage and required inherited five-case regression summaries.
Checked cumulative packaging exact membership, CRC, source-byte hashes and rejection of source-tree symlinks.
Reviewed added runtime provenance block and exercised 15 isolated mutations, including missing and stale source/object files and omitted transitive imports.
limits: This is an independent practical code review with isolated synthetic mutation probes, not a universal correctness proof of Python gate code.
The review does not authenticate hostile evidence or prove the compiler, operating system, dependency binaries, or external process trustworthy.
The Lean shortcut scan is lexical and the axiom report scope is the inventoried named theorem/lemma declarations; the clean compilation and independent source review remain separate required gates.
This review did not run or claim a clean build, production release gate, or packaged release. Final release execution remains required.
The synthetic accepted oracle-shape fixture in the probes is solely a schema-validator control and is not evidence that Lean comparisons ran.

review_updates.change: Added actual Lean runtime provenance closure gate after the initial review.
review_updates.limits: Initial 57-case probe record is preserved with its original tool hashes. This delta review adds 15 separate probes of the changed block.
review_updates.scope: Exact transitive RecorderMain source/object membership, current digests, module count, executable identity and pinned Lean binary digest.
